items.q: The first parts in the trumpet section were divided between Lyman and Lamar who were both fine musicians. I played the 4th part... Lyman and Lamar also blew very loud... when we were doing section work

ctx.x: Sy picked certain musicians to go on the bandstand and I was among the first group. After going down a number, Sy asked some different musicians to come on the stand,but told me to stay there. This procedure went on for an hour or more, and when Sy finally decided on the musicians: he really wanted, which I'm certain that he had an idea in advance about the ones he really wanted before he auditioned the others, I was still there.

When the band started it's first engagement in the Zanzibar club at 48th street and Broadway, the line up was Bill Coleman, Lamar Wright, Sr., Lyman Vunk, Sreets Reed(trumpets)Dickie Wells, Henry Wells(no relation of Dickie)Gus Chappell, Bill Granzow(trombones)Eddie Barefield(also sax-clarinet) George Dorsey(alto sax) Freddie Williams, Gail Curtis(tenor-sax) Williard Brown(baritone sax) Billy Kyle(piano) Aaron Smith(guitar) George Duvivier(bass) Wallace Bishop(drums). Four of the musicians were white. Lyman Vunk,…

To my knowledge, it was the first big band to play a night club in New York that had Negro and white musicians. The first parts in the trumpet section were divided between Lyman and Lamar who were both fine musicians. I played the 4th part and had all the jazz solos. Lyman and Lamar also blew very loud, but never out of tune and I had to blow my lungs out to be heard when we were doing section work, because I had been playing in small groups for 5 or 6 years and gotten out of the habit of blowing loud.
